evidence.quote: Based on my outlook, my preference is to increase the target range 100 basis points by the middle of this year.
Consequently, should the data break against us in the coming weeks, we need to be prepared to hike the policy rate by 50-basis points.
In December, some people were a little surprised to hear me say that inflation was "alarmingly high," but after the latest inflation numbers, I think we all should be alarmed.
I now believe we have achieved the FOMC's objective of maximum employment.
I support starting this process no later than the July FOMC meeting.
Nevertheless, the path of inflation is the biggest risk to my outlook.

spans.quote: Based on my outlook, my preference is to increase the target range 100 basis points by the middle of this year.
Consequently, should the data break against us in the coming weeks, we need to be prepared to hike the policy rate by 50-basis points.
In December, some people were a little surprised to hear me say that inflation was "alarmingly high," but after the latest inflation numbers, I think we all should be alarmed.
I now believe we have achieved the FOMC's objective of maximum employment.
I support starting this process no later than the July FOMC meeting.
Nevertheless, the path of inflation is the biggest risk to my outlook.
